elements.element: Exclusivity restricted to a defined product category (closed scope)
elements.evidence: "with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled)"
"during the twelve (12) month period commencing on the Effective Date (and not during any renewal term)"

elements.element: Automatic end of exclusivity on Vendor's failure to meet service levels
elements.evidence: "shall terminate automatically ... upon HDI's failure to meet any service level"

elements.element: Automatic end of exclusivity on Vendor's failure to meet delivery dates
elements.evidence: "launch date or other delivery date set forth in this Agreement"

elements.element: Preferred: no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binding Customer
elements.evidence: "the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet" (restriction on Company retained)

offending_extra_words: or other delivery date set forth in this Agreement
reasons: Fallback is incomplete: the restraint on the Company still extends beyond a defined product category to "products substantially similar to Deerskin Products" and, via "including, without limitation", to named and unnamed competitor products and "companies similar to" them — an open-ended scope the fallback does not permit.
The 12-month limit and the automatic performance-based release are properly operative and correctly directed at HDI's failures, so those two atomic elements pass.

Minimality fails: "(and not during any renewal term)" is redundant once the period is fixed at twelve months from the Effective Date, and the inserted sentence adds unnecessary boilerplate ("without payment or penalty", "or other delivery date set forth in this Agreement") beyond the service-level/delivery-date trigger the fallback requires; a shorter insertion anchored to a smaller span would suffice.

Fix: replace the similar-product/similar-company language with the defined category ("with respect to Deerskin Products") and trim the added sentence to "The Company's obligations under this Section 6.1 shall terminate automatically upon HDI's failure to meet any service level or delivery date."
Intent is preserved: Section 4.1 term mechanics, Section 6.2 carve-out and HDI's reciprocal rights remain effective, and no undefined term or dangling mechanic is introduced.
